headline: Lebanon rejects direct military coordination with Israel, demands US mediation continue
dek: Tampa trilateral military talks continued Oct 21 at US CENTCOM (MacDill AFB), expected to extend into Wednesday. Lebanon's delegation proposed halting excavation/demolition/firing/Israeli ops and organizing withdrawal + prisoners file.
sources: The National (Lebanese officials), JPost (IDF sources), Beirut Wire, Newscord (Al-Anhar), Anadolu (via americanquorum)
fault_line: Can a ceasefire mechanism work when the two armies won't talk to each other directly — who verifies the verification?

sections.what_happened: Tampa trilateral military talks continued Oct 21 at US CENTCOM (MacDill AFB), expected to extend into Wednesday. Lebanon's delegation proposed halting excavation/demolition/firing/Israeli ops and organizing withdrawal + prisoners file. Lebanon rejects direct military coordination with Israel ('no, we will not do that'); insists on American mediation. Israel wants a direct operations room with the Lebanese army to verify Hezbollah disarmament in pilot zones. Aoun demands end to Israeli operations in Lebanon and IDF withdrawal. Progress on pilot zones stalled since July; no agreed verification mechanism.
sections.what_verified: The National, JPost, ToI, Newscord, americanquorum/Anadolu agree on the agenda, location, and the coordination dispute.
sections.what_disputed: No published outcome; working-level military talks, not political settlement. Initial pilot zones reportedly had no Israeli presence to begin with (critics).
sections.why_matters: The mechanism dispute, not the handshake: pilot zones, the direct-ops-room demand vs the 'no' — hold for a day-2 outcome before a Short; this track feeds the Lebanon election-adjacent coverage.
sections.context: Background: Lebanon — UPDATE to Tampa track (day 2): Beirut Wire: talks extend into Wednesday; The National: Lebanon rejects direct military coordination with Israel, demands US mediation continue; Israel wants direct operations room for pilot-zone verification; Aoun demands end to Israeli ops + withdrawal
